scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Rwanda (2026/2027 Cohort 5, Undergraduate)
scholarships.official_source: University of Rwanda, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation

eligibility: Talented young people from economically disadvantaged backgrounds (official wording)
Seeking a bachelor's degree at the University of Rwanda (undergraduate track)
Detailed eligibility criteria are published inside the online application rather than on the public portal page
existing.eligibility_summary: The official recruitment portal states the programme awards full scholarships for talented young people from economically disadvantaged backgrounds to study for a bachelor's degree at the University of Rwanda. Detailed eligibility criteria are not published on the public landing page; they sit inside the online application.
benefits: Full scholarship to study for a bachelor's degree at the University of Rwanda
coverage: Full scholarship to study for a bachelor's degree at the University of Rwanda
requirements: Submit an application through the programme's online recruitment portal
Apply to the undergraduate track for the 2026/2027 Cohort 5 intake before 12 October 2026, 23:59 Kigali time
Include a full name and application number in any correspondence to the programme
application_method: Apply online through the undergraduate recruitment portal
Use the portal to continue an existing application or to track application status and results
Contact the programme at mcfsp@ur.ac.rw with your full name and application number
existing.selection_notes: The portal states that the postgraduate track for the 2026/2027 intake is closed and that the undergraduate track is open; selection criteria are not published on the public page.
existing.best_fit: Talented young people from economically disadvantaged backgrounds seeking a fully funded bachelor's degree place at the University of Rwanda.
existing.notes: This is the undergraduate track only; the postgraduate track for the same 2026/2027 intake has already closed. The portal does not itemise the benefit breakdown, so coverage is recorded exactly as published ('a full scholarship to study for a bachelor's degree') and living-cost and travel coverage are left null rather than assumed. OVERLAP NOTE FOR MERGE: this is the same Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program umbrella scheme delivered at a different host university from the AUC record in this file; the awarding body here is the University of Rwanda, which runs its own cohort, deadline and selection through its own portal on ur.ac.rw.
existing.application_period: 2026/2027 Cohort 5 undergraduate window, closing 12 October 2026 at 23:59 Kigali time
